title: soliva stolonifera
intro: Soliva stolonifera, commonly known as creeping wax clover or creeping waxweed, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its potential to lower cholesterol levels and regulate blood sugar levels due to its high fiber content. The therapeutic actions of Soliva stolonifera include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which have been shown to provide relief from various health conditions such as arthritis and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
